channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC asserts strait control, US enforces blockade
item.description: Iran's IRGC claims decisive control over the Strait of Hormuz as the US maintains its naval blockade.

item.title: Israeli strike kills three Palestinians in Jenin
item.description: An Israeli drone strike killed three Palestinians in Jenin, the first such attack in the West Bank since February 2025.

item.title: Ebola spreads to two new zones in DRC; 60 areas now affected
item.description: DRC's is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak ever recorded, with 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths.

item.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy plans to hit Russia with ‘1,000 drones’ a day
item.description: Ongoing Russian attacks have killed several people and wounded dozens across Ukraine.

item.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
item.description: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
